'''Vera Vladimirovna Afanasyeva''' ({{langx|ru|Вера Владимировна Афанасьева}}) is a professor at the [[Saratov State University]] and author,<ref name="a">{{cite web|url=https://www.sgu.ru/person/afanaseva-vera-vladimirovna|title=Афанасьева Вера Владимировна - СГУ - Саратовский государственный университет|website=www.sgu.ru}}</ref> [[Ph. D|PhD in Philosophy]], Member of the Petrovskaya Academy of Sciences and Arts.<ref name="a" />

Vera Afanasyeva was born and lives in [[Saratov]].
She graduated from the [[Saratov State University]] in 1984,<ref name="a" /> and earned her [[Candidate of Sciences|Candidat degree]] in 1991.
In 2002, she defended her [[Doktor nauk|doctoral]] thesis.<ref name="a" />

Afanasyeva is the author of 10 monographs and about 200 scientific articles.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://medialeaks64.com/content/vera-afanaseva|title=Вера Афанасьева - Медиаликс 64|website=medialeaks64.com}}</ref>

She has two daughters.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.sarvzglyad.ru/?news_id=614|title=Вера Афанасьева, профессор СГУ: "ХАОС - ЭТО ЗВУЧИТ ГОРДО!" |author=Елена Балаян |website=www.sarvzglyad.ru |language=ru |date=25 March 2007 |access-date=15 February 2019}}</ref>
